msg: I started by choosing 's' for x1 and 'k' for x5 and this worked quite well for round 1. I would recommend choosing purple, brown, orange and green over the other colours for the second round - I had much more success with this than with the 's' and 'k'. From what I could tell, the colour of the basket made very little difference, at least in the third round, but I did not think to try this in the first two, so it may be worth a go. I also tried alternating and that did not seem to be successful.
